_about: Varos cursor set v1 (proposal, 2026-09-23). Hotspots in 32px-logical space, same convention as cursors.rs ai_svg()/hcursor_svg_file(): scale by CURSOR_PX/32 then round. Geometric point = (hx+0.25, hy+0.25) = centre of the hotspot device pixel at 2x. 'ck' = the existing CK variant(s) this file would back; null = no CK exists yet.

rotate.derive: RotateE/SE/S/SW/W/NW/N = this glyph rotated about the hotspot by +45/+90/.../+315 deg

zoom-in.note: needs a new CK::ZoomIn (no zoom tool/cursor kind exists yet)
